text.source: Results: county returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 7, 2026, with about 97% of the expected vote counted statewide. The race has not been called, and counts are unofficial until certified. Independent Ty Pinkins (2.1% statewide) is not shown on the map. Swing compares with the official 2020 U.S. Senate county results for the same seat (two-party share). Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 county estimates (Vintage 2025, table co-est2025-pop-28).
